name: Ranger: Skullpiercer rank 1 stays client-known through buying rank 2, specialization and relog (#6510)
contract: #6510 The Ascension client (patch-B ClassResources.lua) draws the Ranger Advantage bar only while IsSpellIDKnown(802036), Skullpiercer rank 1. The report: the bar vanished between level 9 and choosing talents at level 11, and a relog did not bring it back. Expected: after the Ranger reaches level 10 and buys rank 2 (501715) from the Book of Ascension, the client keeps 802036 through that purchase, through choosing a specialization at level 11, through switching to another specialization and through a relog after each.

steps.label: a level 9 Ranger's client knows Skullpiercer rank 1
rank 2 is not known before level 10
fixture: the Book of Ascension companion spell
the book sells Skullpiercer rank 2 at level 10
after buying rank 2 the client still knows rank 1
after choosing a specialization the client still knows rank 1
after a relog the client still knows rank 1
after a relog the client knows rank 2
after switching specialization the client still knows rank 1
after switching specialization and a relog the client still knows rank 1
